name: open-dmx-console
description: A single-universe web lighting console for ENTTEC Open DMX USB interfaces
author: Open DMX Console contributors

scripts.build: vite build && tsup server/index.ts --format esm --platform node --target node22 --out-dir dist-server --clean --external serialport --external ftdi-d2xx --external vite
scripts.build:desktop-host: tsup desktop/main.ts --format cjs --platform node --target node22 --out-dir dist-desktop --clean --external electron --external serialport --external ftdi-d2xx --external vite
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build && npm run build:desktop-host
scripts.desktop:mac: npm run desktop:build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --x64 --publish never
scripts.desktop:win: npm run desktop:build && electron-builder --win nsis portable --x64 --publish never
